title: Short distance commutes
subtitle: 「短途通勤／短程上班行程／本地通勤／可步行通勤」，究竟是哪一種 short distance commutes？
description: 「短途通勤／短程上班行程／本地通勤／可步行通勤」，究竟是哪一種 short distance commutes？

words.meaning: 短途上班行程；短距離通勤
words.note: 使用者提供。這是 short distance commutes 最直接、自然的改寫之一，強調每次從住處前往工作地點的路程很短。語氣普通、透明，不特別限定交通方式。
words.example: Many employees make short trips to work from nearby neighbourhoods.

exercises.original: The survey found that many residents have short distance commutes of less than three kilometres.
exercises.zh: 調查發現許多居民的上班路程少於三公里。
exercises.upgrade: short trips to work · 短途上班行程；短距離通勤

options.explanation: less than three kilometres 明確表示上班行程本身很短，short trips to work 是最直接的普通改寫。
強調行程每日重複、持續時間短，但本身不必然表示去工作。 但本題的具體線索是 work journeys under three kilometres；本句直接描述一趟趟前往工作地點的短程行程，無需更專門的政策或方法學標籤。 因此 brief daily journeys 不是最佳答案。
最簡潔的一般說法，可依語境理解為距離或時間短。 但本題的具體線索是 work journeys under three kilometres；本句直接描述一趟趟前往工作地點的短程行程，無需更專門的政策或方法學標籤。 因此 short commutes 不是最佳答案。
強調通勤在本地／同一區域內完成，不必然保證每段都非常短。 但本題的具體線索是 work journeys under three kilometres；本句直接描述一趟趟前往工作地點的短程行程，無需更專門的政策或方法學標籤。 因此 local commutes 不是最佳答案。
稍正式、偏英式，聚焦完整的上班旅程。 但本題的具體線索是 work journeys under three kilometres；本句直接描述一趟趟前往工作地點的短程行程，無需更專門的政策或方法學標籤。 因此 short journeys to work 不是最佳答案。
把短距離通勤視為一種抽象交通行為／政策類別。 但本題的具體線索是 work journeys under three kilometres；本句直接描述一趟趟前往工作地點的短程行程，無需更專門的政策或方法學標籤。 因此 short-distance commuting 不是最佳答案。

words.meaning: 短暫的每日行程；短程日常通勤
words.note: 使用者提供。較一般、描述性，強調每天反覆進行、而每次歷時不長的行程。它不一定自帶「上班」意思，因此需要上下文清楚交代是 commuting。
words.example: For many workers, commuting involves only brief daily journeys.

exercises.upgrade: brief daily journeys · 短暫的每日行程；短程日常通勤

options.explanation: a few minutes ... each day emphasizes short duration plus daily repetition, which is exactly brief daily journeys.

words.meaning: 可步行完成的通勤；步行距離內的通勤
words.note: 較窄近義方向。當 short distance commutes 的真正語義重點是距離短到適合步行時，可用 walkable commutes。它不是所有短距離通勤的同義詞，因為有些短途仍未必適合步行。
words.example: Compact neighbourhoods can create more walkable commutes.

exercises.original: The plan aims to increase the number of short distance commutes that can be completed entirely on foot.
exercises.zh: 計劃旨在增加可全程步行完成的通勤數量。
exercises.upgrade: walkable commutes · 可步行完成的通勤；步行距離內的通勤

options.explanation: completed entirely on foot is the defining criterion for walkable commutes.

falseSynonyms.zh: short commutes 是最簡潔的一般改寫；若上下文需要明確指出『距離』而不是時間，則可保留 distance information。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Many staff have short commutes. The study measures commuting distance in kilometres.

falseSynonyms.word: short distance commutes / short trips to work
falseSynonyms.zh: short trips to work 直接描述每一趟工作行程；short commutes 更像整體通勤特徵。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She makes a short trip to work each morning. Her commute is short.

falseSynonyms.word: short distance commutes / brief daily journeys
falseSynonyms.zh: brief daily journeys 強調每天、時間短；它本身未必表示工作通勤，因此需要上下文支持。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Commuting involves brief daily journeys. He also makes brief daily journeys for shopping.

falseSynonyms.zh: local commutes 強調 geographic locality；同一地區內的 commute 未必一定非常短。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Buses handle many local commutes. Some local commutes still take a long time in traffic.

falseSynonyms.zh: walkable commutes 更窄：必須短到且路線條件適合步行；短距離並不自動等於可步行。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The project aims to create more walkable commutes. A short commute across a motorway may not be walkable.

falseSynonyms.zh: short-distance commuting 是抽象行為／政策類別；short commutes 則可直接指個別人的通勤。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The paper studies short-distance commuting. Many employees have short commutes.

falseSynonyms.word: short distance commutes / nearby work trips
falseSynonyms.zh: nearby work trips 強調目的地就在附近；不是所有 local travel 都是 commute，亦不是所有 commute 都需要這種描述性片語。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The walking route serves nearby work trips. The employee's commute crosses the whole city.

falseSynonyms.zh: commute 特指規律往返住處與工作／學習地點；journey 是任何從一地到另一地的行程。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She commutes to work every day. The holiday journey took six hours.
